decoded.meaning: BATCH{ TIME u64=1700000000000000000, VALUE u16=0x0064, VALUE u16=0x0065, VALUE u16=0x0066 } — a UNIFORM stream's fold: the base sample time is one payload TIME child, and the three sample frames carry NO time of their own. With the descriptor's dt_ns = 1000, t(i) = 1700000000000000000 + i*1000 (RFC-0025 §4.2.1, Amendment 1)
decoded.note: the record carries NO trailer: wire/TX time is opt.TS on the OUTERMOST frame only and always TF=0, and a written value is an inner TLV. An implementation that spends a per-sample trailer (the retired §4.2 spelling) emits 4 more bytes per sample and does not produce these bytes; one that reads the second child as an offset array has ignored the descriptor's dt_ns
